text: 7月10日，中国人民银行举办专题讲座，中国人民银行党委书记、行长潘功胜出席并主持讲座。清华大学国家金融研究院院长、国际货币基金组织（IMF）前副总裁朱民以“国际货币体系演变——理论与实践”为题，围绕国际货币体系发展进程、货币国际化衡量标准、数字货币发展等问题，介绍了研究成果和建设性思考，并与现场参加人员进行了交流。
text_en: On July 10, the People's Bank of China held a special lecture, attended and chaired by PBOC Secretary and Governor Pan Gongsheng. Zhu Min, Dean of the Institute of National Financial Research at Tsinghua University and former Vice President of the IMF, gave a lecture titled 'Evolution of the International Monetary System: Theory and Practice,' covering research results and constructive thoughts on the development of the international monetary system, criteria for currency internationalization, and the progress of digital currencies, followed by exchanges with participants.
